name: FAQ · restaurant dark gold
description: Black and gold two-column FAQ for a fine-dining venue.

items.question: How do I reserve a table?
items.answer: Book online up to 60 days in advance, or call us after 2pm. Parties of eight or more are handled by phone.

items.question: Do you cater for allergies?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us when booking and our chef will adapt the menu. We cook with nuts and shellfish in the kitchen.

items.question: Is there a dress code?
items.answer: Smart casual. We ask guests to avoid sportswear and beachwear.

items.question: Can I book a private room?
items.answer: Our cellar room seats up to 18 and has its own tasting menu. Enquire for availability.

items.question: What are your corkage terms?
items.answer: Corkage is $35 per bottle, with a limit of one bottle per table.
